# SYRM

SYRM captures real-world human demonstrations across physical tasks and environments for robotics, embodied AI, and physical AI teams.

## What SYRM Provides

- Human demonstration data collected in homes, kitchens, shops, workshops, warehouses, outdoor environments, and other real-world settings.
- Structured multimodal datasets for robot training pipelines.
- First-person task demonstrations with video, metadata, microtask segmentation, sensor traces, trajectories, and quality review.
- Custom data collection programs scoped around a customer's task list, environment requirements, capture setup, and delivery criteria.

## Core Topics

- Physical AI training data
- Robotics datasets
- Embodied AI
- Human demonstrations
- Egocentric video capture
- Manipulation trajectories
- Multimodal robot learning data
- Real-world data collection
